title: A Hymn for the Room
author: Noor Kavanagh
blurb: Beatrix Pemberton, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, has spent ten years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
